verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official MCP server. Its developer docs invite you to build an app, agent, or bot that integrates with a Capacities space via an MCP client, and a probe confirms the MCP page exists. Its Chat Connectors connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Le Chat to a space, with Version history to undo unwanted changes made by an external assistant. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and no detail on the exposed tools, transport, or auth flow.
